content.name: Rebecca Thornton
content.title: Programme Manager
content.summary: Programme manager with 17 years delivering change in social housing, water and rail, now leading a £68m digital signalling upgrade programme in the north of England. PRINCE2 Practitioner and APM PMQ holder with a strong record of recovering projects that were running late. Calm in front of boards, regulators and contractors alike.

experience.title: Programme Manager
bullets: Lead a £68m programme of six signalling and telecoms projects with 11 project managers and four delivery partners.
Recovered a project that was 14 weeks behind by re-sequencing possessions with the operator, returning it to its baseline date.
Report monthly to the alliance board on cost, schedule, risk and benefits, with forecast accuracy within 3% for two years.
Set up a shared lessons-learned log now used across all alliance programmes.

experience.title: Senior Project Manager
bullets: Managed IT and business change projects for public sector clients worth up to £9m each.
Delivered a case management system for a regional probation services client used by 900 staff, on budget.
Introduced hybrid Agile and PRINCE2 governance that cut stage-gate approval time by 30%.

experience.title: Project Manager
bullets: Ran asset improvement projects for treatment works, with budgets between £1m and £6m.
Coordinated contractors and operations during a smart metering pilot for 20,000 homes.
Kept CDM 2015 duties documented across every site and passed all internal health and safety audits.

experience.title: Project Officer
bullets: Organised kitchen and bathroom replacement works across 1,100 homes with three contractors.
Ran resident liaison and complaints tracking, reducing open complaints by 45% over a year.
Prepared project reports for the board's asset committee.

achievements.title: Project recovery recognition
achievements.detail: Alliance director's commendation (2023) for bringing the signalling project back to baseline.

achievements.title: APM volunteer
achievements.detail: Volunteer speaker at APM regional branch events on programme recovery.
